  • Join the Library

If you live, work, or study in Shropshire you can join Shropshire Libraries - it's free.

 

Completing this form will give you instant access to our online services, including e-books and audio and our online catalogue.

 

To borrow physical items, you will need to collect a library card from one of our libraries. Please take along your new online membership number and proof of name, if you have it.
